base.role: CUDA 13.0.3, PyTorch and vendor runtime libraries only. SGLang (with its Rust extensions), FlashInfer with its cubin bundle and DeepGEMM are rebuilt from the sources below.

patches.head: 91da44cda946f1de98d7bdb1863eda2b5aa7298a
patches.purpose: Checkpoint files holding host-resident weights (the V4.1 Engram tables) stay off the InstantTensor GPU stream.
patches.note: #42919 stacks its one commit on #40453, which merged as 6e8f3e09dd; only that commit is carried.
patches.resolution: deepseek_v4.py: host_resident_weight_patterns sits next to the get_hf_to_sglang_mapper main added to DeepseekV4ForCausalLM.

patches.head: 128e20a48e94d2bd08f63690069c59af8aa94c49

patches.resolution: Production code applies unchanged on #42787, which shards Engram tables on hash-column boundaries; the row test passes the new column_bounds argument and covers both the column-aligned and the equal-row split.

patches.head: 2f2173c1191ad4da45fcd3046d025c6ba3707a2b
patches.purpose: Run the V4.1 candidate indexer on SM12x through the paged decode path.

patches.head: 08767482e4b5391c151b7924ef9072451fcec1e1
patches.purpose: Map packed compact-verify tokens to their requests for Engram hashing (replaces sgl-project/sglang#40567).
patches.note: Carries the PR's own commits 656f3759e4 and 08767482e4; the #42709 commit between them is in main.

patches.head: 8c443d975e4f24084689b04599867ed0b5ea24ed
patches.purpose: Apply a pinned DSpark verify budget while the SPS table is uninitialized.

patches.head: 9b9441d85b5f010d829023abe057baaf2bef05fb
patches.purpose: SM120 FlashMLA page-split buffers are allocated once per size, so captured CUDA graphs never write freed memory.

patches.head: 4ab7d55691ae7f64a6704fccd4368fef53938dbd
patches.purpose: Every TP rank resolves the same relayed DSpark confidence (no rank-local readiness check, no unordered buffer overwrite).

patches.head: add06272997c128f477621da3c38c933d41baa8b
patches.purpose: Forced-uniform compact verify captures key by token count and carry a full-width layout, matching replay.
patches.resolution: #42709 is in main: the forced-uniform early return it kept in _capture_ragged_verify_layout is replaced by the full-width layout, keeping its per-tier layout cache.

patches.head: 529a4c9ac6ed87b3c712070ac9d01520299cb44d
patches.purpose: DSpark STS calibration labels come from the actual acceptance, with unverified positions masked out.
patches.resolution: Main (#43790) passes confidence_raw to the step observers: the STS recorder takes it from the caller and labels with correct_len; the test passes confidence_raw.

patches.head: d03509e642df77999ef3470ef54a03cda7017f76
patches.purpose: Decode FP4 index keys without exp2 in the Triton scorer (bit-identical).

patches.head: 1a5573c0e356bacc6843c98ccdd8ba8ac6ff3107
patches.purpose: Split-K MXFP8 GEMM for tuned decode-sized linears at up to 16 rows (SGLANG_ENABLE_SM120_MXFP8_SKINNY_GEMM, default on).

patches.head: d57e9f784e782d98fc2bed7b8ddfc7ee9fe8b488
patches.purpose: Vectorized mHC split-K reduce; 160 K slices for SM120 decode and verify.
patches.resolution: Ported to the boundary stages of #43607: the boundary read records decode/verify on ReadState and HcUpdate.post passes it to the posts next to main's precomputed stats; _num_stages_for, replaced by #43070, is not restored. The unit test drives HcReadCall.read and HcUpdate.post.

patches.head: 9486c1c0f457dde7e1edde915b6f5471ddc150fe
patches.purpose: Wide prefill computes the mHC mix stats while the TP all-reduce runs again (restores the overlap #42245 removed).
patches.resolution: Ported to the layer-boundary transports of #43607, which complete the TP all-reduces in TransportExit.finish: AttentionTransport and MoeTransport fork the stats stream and issue the triplet in prepare_output right before the owed sum, and HcUpdate.post joins it. Same gating as the PR; the unit test is rewritten for the transports.

patches.head: 1581a8f367ae5972a7122085cd30102cb3fcd07a
patches.purpose: TP4 logits and DSpark vocab all-gathers use FlashInfer's PCIe-IPC all-gather where its all-reduce is enabled (SGLANG_ENABLE_PCIE_IPC_ALLREDUCE).

patches.head: 95efd58ec3ca093a5492501c0ab253eadba6474c
patches.purpose: Encoder-replay request window checks its history once per layout with an async device assert, without a host sync; removes the per-layer prefill stalls.
patches.resolution: #42715, which it stacked on, is replaced by #44555 in main: the check sits before main's copy_packed_tokens, and its tests move to test_request_window_history_check.py.

patches.head: ca8c33877dfeabf73fc1f0dfa4c2f33ae6113a6a
patches.purpose: Opt-in weight-streaming BF16 GEMM for LM heads at up to 16 rows (SGLANG_ENABLE_BF16_SKINNY_LM_HEAD); batch-invariant rows.
patches.resolution: environ.py: main dropped the folded-sampling variables next to the new one (#43668).

patches.head: 59698efe687515e20d5d2136b5a73c07cf40a759
patches.purpose: --warmups serving_coverage drives real requests through every serving path before the server accepts traffic, including concurrent decodes at every power-of-two batch size up to the running-request limit (replaces the carried decode_batches warmup).

patches.head: 7957c5eadf980ef642fde023bbe0f8650ad7fd8a
patches.reason: The branch head moved to 7957c5eadf (rebased on main 5cbf949839; the fit prices padding tokens of the executed tier and a failed measurement keeps the configured table only once the schedulers confirm its end). CPU-tested (63 tests); the upstream PR is posted with GPU measurements.
patches.purpose: --speculative-dspark-sps-autotune off|auto|force: fit the DSpark SPS cost table at startup from real decode steps per (batch size, verify tier) plus a per-verify-token context term, cached per configuration (no manual profiling step).
patches.resolution: Main (#43623) applies SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN through a one-element length buffer in build_accept_outs: the bonus-only measurement zeroes the accepted length itself, keeps the real accept's row-0 token and hands build_accept_outs no simulated length; the in-graph accept stays off while measuring.

patches.head: 7732726de2839033baca6f97eb18c5ed291387da
patches.reason: Restored opt-in (SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_SUB_WIDTH_TIERS, off unless the deployment sets it): 0.2.0 ran with it; #43011 was closed on a single-sample measurement. The deployment A/B decides.
patches.purpose: Opt-in ragged-verify token tiers below one request's width (SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_SUB_WIDTH_TIERS).
patches.resolution: Main names each capture trace with _set_profile_trace_tag: a sub-width capture's tag is tokens_<n>.

patches.head: 63db9087e02da33250892674a930dc8689e34504
patches.purpose: Skip top-p renormalization on compact-verify padding rows (Triton fill of the padding rows instead of a gathered copy).
patches.resolution: Main added block_verification to the same accept signatures and a one-hot greedy-draft branch: both parameters are passed and the padding lengths follow either branch.

patches.head: 5507fc9b34c62cc73656122151db39ffb94103be
patches.purpose: Compact verify hands self-adding backends committed CPU lengths, as static verify does.

patches.head: 103ad321d2f870c191dc71d470a375d0a51e9170
patches.purpose: Paged decode consumer layers score only their candidate blocks.
patches.resolution: decode_scores keeps main's compute_topk_plan (#41561); fp4_index_logits_candidates allocates with the DeepSelect row alignment fp4_index_logits_paged uses since #44210.

patches.head: 58adb15f18cff50f0ccb22ea776441129a46abf0
patches.purpose: SM120 decode/verify WO-A reads an exact FP8 copy of its BF16 weight (SGLANG_DSV41_WO_A_FP8_COPY, default on).
patches.resolution: gemm/__init__.py: its kernel registrations follow #42867's, as in the 0.3.0 rebased copy.

patches.head: 986d040298175230cce94ec795834b475888b8c4
patches.purpose: Encoder SWA bounded replay accepts image requests: the replay window carries the request's own multimodal inputs, so image prompts keep HiCache host-tier hits.
patches.resolution: Main (#43166) folds replay rows into the extend on the DeepSeek-V4 backend and batches the other backends' replay: the folded extend already carries each request's items, the batched replay now carries them too; tests cover both.

patches.head: c65373886d52dc3d44a747da8fd7c4d2ee0eedd9
patches.purpose: DSv4.1 prefill indexer score tiles sized from free memory with their scratch counted and no padded copy, so tile memory no longer grows with context length (OOM crash fix).
patches.resolution: Main (#44051) aligns every flat score tile to FLAT_LOGITS_WIDTH_ALIGN and can score in bf16: the per-scorer width_align is dropped, the publisher's block-aligned slice relies on that alignment, and the scratch-aware sizing keeps main's bf16 row estimate.

patches.head: 4070feebb9033b56e31e9f7497662116e79a3c72
patches.reason: Reviewed (Codex) and CPU-tested. Recorded C1 sessions on rc18 show the host planner sizes each step from confidences two steps old; a per-request running average models +1.2% (short context) and +2.7% (143K) at C1, no change at C2/C4. Enabled in the deployment with SGLANG_DSPARK_BUDGET_SURVIVAL_EMA.
patches.purpose: DSpark host budget planner sizes each step from a per-request running average of the lagged survival (opt-in); request-pool generations stay unique across a pool clear.
patches.resolution: Main (#43439) already keeps request-pool generations counting across a clear; that part of the change is dropped.

patches.head: 621aeac1fbceafa1d116029eb0ab030147b410d2
patches.purpose: DSpark read_accept returns copies, not views of the buffers the next verify replay rewrites, so TP ranks commit the same token counts under the overlap scheduler with HiCache. Amended for main with #43790: the in-graph accept writes the static buffers through _accept_buffers (PR head 7a8f74963c9d made it write into read_accept copies, so commit_lens read back as 0 and 0.4.0-rc.2 crashed on a negative correct-draft count).

patches.head: f297d19301e19f1f7af4e93f5fb11e94bbb4e0f9
patches.reason: Prepared for sgl-project/sglang (Python, sglang-processor and sglang-server); opencode-reviewed, review findings resolved; PR awaits owner approval.
patches.purpose: Chat and completions usage also report reasoning tokens at usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, where OpenAI clients and gateways read them; the top-level usage.reasoning_tokens stays.
patches.resolution: Applied onto the 0.4.0 series with git apply --3way; Rust test helpers and fixtures merge cleanly.

packaging.rationale: SGLang main pins the published FlashInfer 0.7.2; FlashInfer main is 0.7.2 with no wheel published for that commit, so its pin is kept at the same version and the cubin bundle is built from the same commit (its downloader verifies the source-pinned checksum manifest). DeepGEMM stays at the dev commit cbe1727e: dev has since merged an upstream release that removes the SM120 MQA-logits kernels and changes the fp8_fp4_mqa_logits signature SGLang main calls, so it gets SGLang's required version (0.2.2, which cbe1727e contains) plus a local commit suffix. typeguard 4 repairs the vendor base's typeguard conflict, Pillow stays at the vendor's patched >=12.3, NCCL keeps the vendor's deliberate 2.30.7 floor, and MoviePy is an unused diffusion extra whose Pillow<12 bound would downgrade the decoder.

allowed_conflicts: The package `cosmos-guardrail` requires `imageio>=2.37.0`, but `2.36.0` is installed
The package `cosmos-guardrail` requires `opencv-python>=4.10.0.84`, but it's not installed
The package `retinaface-py` requires `opencv-python`, but it's not installed
The package `nixl` requires `nixl-cu12==1.5.0`, but it's not installed
The package `ai-dynamo-runtime` requires `pydantic>=2.10.6,<=2.13.5`, but `2.14.1` is installed
dependency_gate.rationale: The vendor base deliberately substitutes headless OpenCV, CUDA 13 NIXL and NCCL 2.30.7, and SGLang's diffusion extra pins imageio 2.36.0. The 20261016 vendor base ships ai-dynamo-runtime (NVIDIA Dynamo, never imported by SGLang) with pydantic 2.14.1; this build changes neither package. Every other `uv pip check` result fails the build.

added_dependencies.name: instanttensor
added_dependencies.reason: Runtime backend of the InstantTensor loader (sgl-project/sglang#40453, in main; SGLang lists instanttensor>=0.1.9 only in its test extra). Its only requirement, torch>=2.8.0, is already met; installed without resolution and hash-checked.

hardware.interconnect: PCIe across NUMA nodes; no NVLink

flashinfer_patches.purpose: PCIe-IPC all-reduce tuner: barrier before the collective warm-up, copy-engine ring depth bounded by max_blocks, and alternating candidate order in the ranking rounds (approved upstream).

triton_patches.head: 0d564c5bbf5f24ccf39fc28f9d7c44f58a50adb5
triton_patches.purpose: Backport of main's dot-operand rematerialization fix: Triton 3.8.0 (#11108, issue #11526) sends tf32x3 dot operands through extra shared-memory round trips (2-3x slower pipelined split-K on SM120).
